map.品位储量 = 品位 × 体积 × 体重: Grade reserve = grade × volume × bulk density
map.💡 公式：矿石量 Q = S × M × D（吨）；金属量 P = Q × C%: 💡 Formula: ore tonnage Q = S × M × D (tonnes); metal content P = Q × C% (when the grade is entered in %, P = Q × C/100).
map.品位以质量百分比输入；贵金属以 g/t 时请换算为%: The grade is entered as a mass percentage; for precious metals in g/t, convert to %

map.配矿评估：对比相邻块段品位，判断能否合并开采或需分采: Ore blending assessment: compare the grades of adjacent blocks to judge whether they can be mined together or must be mined separately
map.报告初算：勘探初期用本工具做概略资源量，支撑下一步详查部署: Preliminary report calculation: use this tool for a preliminary resource estimate in early exploration to support the next detailed survey
map.算法：体积 V = 面积 S × 平均厚度 M；矿石量 Q = V × 体重 D: Algorithm: volume V = area S × average thickness M; ore tonnage Q = V × bulk density D; metal content P = Q × grade C / 100. Also gives the metal grade kg/t = P/Q×1000 and g/t = P/Q×10⁶ (computed locally; units must be unified to m, t/m³ and %).
map.例：矿体 S=50000 m²、M=3.5 m、D=2.7 t/m³、C=1.2: Example: ore body S=50000 m², M=3.5 m, D=2.7 t/m³, C=1.2% → V=175000 m³, Q=472500 t (472,500 tonnes), P=5670 t (5,670 tonnes), metal grade 12.0 kg/t (=12000 g/t).
